carbon_price_semantics: CEA observations may be used only as an internal shadow-price, policy-expansion, or upstream-pass-through scenario. They are not a current statutory road-logistics allowance cost.
appledouble_event: AppleDouble sidecars were created by the external-volume download path during acquisition, detected before final hashing, removed, and excluded from the manifest. Final scan is clean.
known_limits: Monthly proxy-purchase electricity prices are time-specific and are not a permanent regional tariff.
The NDRC diesel attachment gives standard-product ceilings in CNY/t. Do not invent CNY/L conversions without a same-date official local conversion/retail notice.
Guangdong province policy explicitly excludes Shenzhen; Shenzhen has a separate policy and must not be silently replaced by Guangzhou/Foshan values.
The Chengdu--Chongqing corridor crosses Sichuan and Chongqing. A Chongqing electricity tariff cannot price the Chengdu side without a documented surrogate decision.
